question: Why is the ancestral year called deluded?
premises: They deludedly called the ancestral year a divine day
Thousands of divine sun-years occur in ages
inference: The verse criticizes a mistaken equation of ancestral and divine time.
uncertainties: caturāditaḥ may refer to four ages
plain_english: They deludedly called the ancestral year a divine day, in vain; thousands of divine sun-years occur in the ages, from four onward.
